description: Wire a texture set to a material in a project: the colour map to `map`, the normal map to `normalMap`, the ambient-occlusion / roughness / metalness map to `aoMap` + `roughnessMap` (+ `metalnessMap` when the set is metallic), the SAME repeat on every map, the material colour white and roughness 1 (THREE multiplies the colour map by the colour and the roughness map by the roughness: a grey #808080 colour would show the texture at half brightness, the default roughness 0.5 would halve every roughness; the colour's alpha, the opacity, is kept). A Color the material shares with another component is left as it is, and the material gets its own new white Color; the answer says which. Creates one Texture per map, or reuses a Texture of the project already on that image. MaterialStandard / Physical get every map; Lambert / Phong / Toon get map, normalMap and aoMap; Basic is refused (unlit). `repeat` is how often the tile repeats across the surface (both axes); or give `worldSize` in metres: a number for a square surface (1000 for a 1 km terrain with 1 m gravel), or {x, y} for its two sides ({"x": 2, "y": 40} for a 2 m × 40 m path), giving repeatX = x / the set's tile size and repeatY = y / it, so a long strip does not stretch the texture. Give neither and the mesh using the material is measured (its own geometry size times its scale, as r3_component_bounds measures; the two largest sides). Kept at once in the project's live copy: every R3 tab with the project open shows it.

material.description: The material to wire: its entityRef or id (r3_project_load), e.g. "material_ground".

repeat.description: How often the texture repeats across the surface, on both axes and every map.

worldSize.description: Or: the surface size in metres, a number (square) or {x, y} (its two sides, e.g. {"x": 2, "y": 40} for a 2 m × 40 m path); repeatX = x / the set's tile size (1 m for the presets), repeatY = y / it. Neither given: the mesh(es) using the material are measured.

name: r3_texture_apply

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Put a texture set on a material
